This comparison analyzes the supplementary calculation of [[asa-score|ASA]] scores for operated patients, specifically focusing on the preoperative comorbidity burden of acute surgical patients across Denmark's five healthcare regions: [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]], [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]], [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]], [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]], and [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] [^src1]. 

The evaluation maps the [[asa-score|ASA]] physical status classification levels, which range from 1 to 7, to assess patient health status prior to acute surgery [^src1]. The statistical analysis was conducted over three distinct periods, focusing on the first quartile (Q1), median, mean, and third quartile (Q3) to capture the full distribution of patient acuity [^src1]. 

When evaluating leaders and trailers across the shared measures, the data reveals a highly uniform clinical landscape rather than distinct regional outliers. The primary conclusion drawn from the regional distributions is that the differences in ASA scores between the regions are not significant [^src1]. Consequently, no single region exhibits a substantially higher or lower acuity profile for acute surgical interventions, indicating a consistent baseline of patient health status across the national healthcare system [^src1]. While the exact numerical cell values for the boxplot distributions are omitted in the structured data extraction, the overarching statistical parameters (Q1, median, Q3) and the definitive conclusion of regional parity remain clearly documented [^src1].

For broader context, methodology, and related regional metrics concerning acute surgical patients and ASA classifications across the 2023 and 2024 reporting cycles, extensive supplementary data and analyses are provided throughout the respective annual databases [^src2] [^src3] [^src4] [^src5] [^src6] [^src7] [^src8] [^src9] [^src10] [^src11] [^src12] [^src13].

**Summary:** Tabellen viser regionale fordelinger af ASA-score (1–7) for akut kirurgiske patienter over tre perioder, med fokus på Q1, median, gennemsnit og Q3, og konkluderer, at forskellene mellem regionerne ikke er væsentlige.
